what: A spinning newspaper flying in — the page plate, rotated .4× and 720°, rises from 25vw below the screen to −18vw over 2s expo.inOut (two full turns, so it looks upright), rests .5s, then unwinds the two turns backward over 2s expo.inOut while unfolding to full size and settles into place over 1.5s (4.5s in total). Scroll is locked meanwhile and fx:done fires at the end. The html background (stage color) shows around the plate — the old-movie newspaper headline scene

options.rise: Position where it rises and stops (vw), default −18
options.min: Does not spin below this width (px), default 992

use: <main data-fx="spin-in-page" data-fx-spin-in-page="spin: 1.2; settle: 1">…</main>  (the html background is the stage — usually --kf-contrast-bg)

from.where: index.html #app — original Webflow IX2 ‹Loader› (PAGE_START, 992px and up): scale .4 · rotateZ 720° · y 25vw → y −18vw 2s inOutExpo → .5s later scale 1 · rotate 0 2s, y 0 1.5s inOutExpo

note: To show the first picture already small and spun, the using side’s css lays the same initial state (translate3d(0,25vw,0) scale(.4) rotate(720deg), transform-origin 50% 10%) as a marker class and removes that marker on fx:done. Without it the first picture shows once at full size and then shrinks. position: fixed elements inside the panel (nav · curtain) rotate with the panel while it spins.
